description: Defines built-in acknowledgement label constants used within the Ditto project, specifically for indicating status in entity persistence and response handling.

classes.name: DittoAcknowledgementLabel
classes.description: A final class representing specific built-in acknowledgement labels for the Ditto framework, providing constants and utility methods.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an array of the predefined Ditto acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a given acknowledgement label is one of the predefined Ditto acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality based on the delegate's value and class type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the delegate label.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the delegate label.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at a specified index in the delegate label.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the delegate label.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the delegate label.
